mapper.sql: SELECT p.policy_id policyId,v.version_id versionId,p.policy_code policyCode,p.display_name displayName, v.version_no versionNo,v.state,v.default_combination_policy defaultCombinationPolicy, v.allow_stacking allowStacking,FALSE memberPriceEligible,v.effective_at effectiveAt, v.expires_at expiresAt,v.revocation_epoch revocationEpoch,v.content_sha256 contentSha256, v.created_by createdBy,v.approved_by approvedBy,v.version FROM mbr_benefit_version v JOIN mbr_benefit_policy p ON p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.policy_id=v.policy_id
mapper.select: WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.policy_id=#{policyId} AND v.version_id=#{versionId}
WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.policy_id=#{policyId} AND v.version_id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.policy_id policyId,v.version_id versionId,p.policy_code policyCode,p.display_name displayName, v.version_no versionNo,v.state,v.default_combination_policy defaultCombinationPolicy, m.stacking_allowed allowStacking,m.member_price_eligible memberPriceEligible, v.effective_at effectiveAt,v.expires_at expiresAt,v.revocation_epoch revocationEpoch, v.content_sha256 contentSha256,v.created_by createdBy,v.approved_by approvedBy,v.version FROM mbr_benefit_version v JOIN mbr_benefit_policy p ON p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.policy_id=v.policy_id JOIN mbr_benefit_scope s ON s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.version_id=v.version_id AND s.store_id=#{storeId} JOIN mbr_benefit_level_mapping m ON m.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND m.version_id=v.version_id AND m.level_code=#{levelCode} WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.state IN ('ACTIVE','SCHEDULED') AND v.effective_at<=#{at} AND (v.expires_at IS NULL OR v.expires_at>#{at})

SELECT snapshot_id snapshotId,member_ref_hash memberRefHash,level_history_id levelHistoryId, level_code levelCode,benefit_version_id benefitVersionId,store_id storeId, member_price_eligible memberPriceEligible,stacking_allowed stackingAllowed, effective_at effectiveAt,expires_at expiresAt,revocation_epoch revocationEpoch, rights_digest rightsDigest,content_sha256 contentSha256 FROM mbr_entitlement_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND snapshot_id=#{snapshotId}

SELECT v.version_id versionId,m.level_code levelCode,m.member_price_eligible memberPriceEligible, m.stacking_allowed stackingAllowed,v.default_combination_policy defaultCombinationPolicy, v.allow_stacking policyAllowStacking,v.revocation_epoch revocationEpoch, v.effective_at effectiveAt,v.expires_at expiresAt, SHA2(CONCAT(v.content_sha256,':',m.content_sha256,':',s.content_sha256),256) contentSha256 FROM mbr_benefit_version v JOIN mbr_benefit_scope s ON s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.version_id=v.version_id AND s.store_id=#{storeId} JOIN mbr_benefit_level_mapping m ON m.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND m.version_id=v.version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.state IN ('SCHEDULED','ACTIVE') AND v.effective_at<#{windowEnd} AND (v.expires_at IS NULL OR v.expires_at>#{windowStart}) ORDER BY m.level_code,v.version_no,v.version_id
